2026-07-23 11:30:15.756362 | controller |
2026-07-23 11:30:15.756366 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-23 11:30:15.756369 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-23 11:30:15.756373 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-23 11:30:15.756376 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-23 11:30:15.756380 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-23 11:30:15.756383 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-07-23 11:30:15.756386 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
